fields.name: Date Palm
fields.about: A tall flowering palm cultivated for thousands of years for its sweet edible fruit. It thrives in hot, dry climates and can live for over 100 years.
fields.used_for: Fresh and dried dates are eaten as food; the fronds are woven into mats and baskets and the trunk is used in construction.
fields.native_to: Saudi Arabia, Iraq, Egypt, North Africa

fields.name: Olive Tree
fields.about: An evergreen tree with silvery-green leaves and a twisted trunk, famous for its small oily fruit. Some olive trees are over 1,000 years old.
fields.used_for: Olives are eaten cured and pressed into olive oil for cooking, cosmetics and soap; the wood is used for carving.

fields.name: Neem
fields.about: A fast-growing, drought-resistant evergreen tree with bitter leaves. It is widely planted for shade in hot regions, including the Arabian Peninsula.
fields.used_for: Used in traditional medicine, natural pesticides, toothpaste and soap; twigs are used as natural toothbrushes.

fields.name: Mango
fields.about: A tropical stone fruit with sweet, juicy orange flesh. The mango tree can grow up to 30 meters tall.
fields.used_for: Eaten fresh, in juices, smoothies, desserts, chutneys and pickles.

fields.name: Pomegranate
fields.about: A shrub or small tree producing a round fruit filled with hundreds of juicy red seeds (arils).
fields.used_for: The arils are eaten fresh or pressed into juice; used in salads, molasses, and traditional medicine.

fields.name: Strawberry
fields.about: A low-growing plant producing bright red, sweet and aromatic fruit with seeds on the outside.
fields.used_for: Eaten fresh, in jams, desserts, ice cream, milkshakes and as a flavoring.

fields.name: Tomato
fields.about: A fast-growing plant producing juicy red fruits that are commonly used as a vegetable in cooking.
fields.used_for: Used in salads, sauces, soups, ketchup and countless dishes around the world.

fields.name: Carrot
fields.about: A root vegetable, typically orange, that is crunchy and rich in beta-carotene.
fields.used_for: Eaten raw, cooked, juiced, and used in soups, salads and cakes.

fields.name: Spinach
fields.about: A leafy green vegetable rich in iron, vitamins and minerals, grown in cool seasons.
fields.used_for: Eaten raw in salads or cooked in pies (fatayer), soups and stews.

fields.name: Basil
fields.about: An aromatic herb from the mint family with fragrant green leaves.
fields.used_for: Used fresh in cooking, pesto, salads and teas; also used in traditional medicine.

fields.name: Mint
fields.about: A fast-spreading aromatic herb with a cool, refreshing flavor.
fields.used_for: Added to tea, drinks, salads like tabbouleh, and used in toothpaste and medicine for digestion.

fields.name: Rosemary
fields.about: A woody, evergreen herb with needle-like fragrant leaves and small blue flowers.
fields.used_for: Used to flavor meats, breads and potatoes; its oil is used in perfumes and hair care.

fields.name: Rose
fields.about: A woody flowering shrub known for its beautiful, fragrant flowers. Taif in Saudi Arabia is famous for its roses.
fields.used_for: Grown as an ornamental plant; petals are distilled into rose water and perfume oil.

fields.name: Moth Orchid
fields.about: A popular orchid (Phalaenopsis) with long-lasting flowers shaped like moths in flight.
fields.used_for: Grown as a decorative houseplant and in floral arrangements.

fields.name: Sunflower
fields.about: A tall plant with a large yellow flower head that follows the sun when young.
fields.used_for: Seeds are eaten as snacks and pressed into sunflower oil; also used as an ornamental plant.

fields.name: Aloe Vera
fields.about: A thick-leaved succulent that stores water in its leaves and grows well in dry climates.
fields.used_for: The gel inside the leaves is used in skin care, burns treatment and cosmetics.

fields.name: Prickly Pear
fields.about: A cactus with flat, paddle-shaped pads and sweet colorful fruits covered with small spines.
fields.used_for: The fruit is eaten fresh or made into juice and jam; the pads (nopales) are cooked as vegetables.

fields.name: Echeveria
fields.about: A rosette-shaped succulent with fleshy, pastel-colored leaves. Very easy to grow indoors.
fields.used_for: Grown as an ornamental plant in pots, rock gardens and terrariums.

fields.content: Sukkari dates from Qassim are the best!
